transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I'm just having some trouble with my work lately. I teach high school, and... I don't know. I'll sit down with a stack of essays or, you know, a curriculum document, fully intending to get it done. But... maybe ten minutes later, I'll realize I've just been staring at the exact same page. 

My mind is usually off on three other things, and I'm barely taking in what's right in front of me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you feel anxious or worried when you're sitting there staring at the page?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I feel anxious. I'm just... sort of blank, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad lately?
No... I don't think so. I'm fine in that regard. Just... normal, I guess.
Does this happen to you in other areas of your life, outside of work?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it as much at home, I guess. It's mostly just... the school stuff.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or blurting out answers before they finish speaking?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I do that. I usually just wait for people to finish.
Do you often find yourself doing things on impulse, without fully thinking them through?
No, not really. I don't... I don't think I do things on impulse. I'm pretty cautious, I guess.
Do you often feel tired or lacking in energy?
Um... no, not really. I mean, just the normal amount, I guess. I don't feel like I lack energy.
Are you finding it difficult to cope with your daily life because of these problems you're having with focusing on your work?

Yeah... I guess it is getting a bit difficult. Um, at school, my department chair actually put me on a support plan recently... just because of missed follow-throughs and stuff. And, uh, at home... my wife has started taking over the bills and the reminders. She just feels like she can't really count on me to keep track of them anymore.
Do you think you've been avoiding certain tasks or responsibilities at school because you feel overwhelmed by them?
Um... no, I don't think so. I don't really avoid things on purpose. I wouldn't say I feel overwhelmed, I just... I don't know, I just don't always get to them.
Do you feel stressed when you think about not being able to keep up with your work?
Um... not really. I mean, I don't know if stressed is the right word for it. I just... try not to dwell on it too much, I guess. It just kind of is what it is.
Do you often feel guilty or criticize yourself for not getting things done?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I beat myself up about it or anything. Like I said, I just... I don't really dwell on it.
Do you often worry about things in general?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really much of a worrier. I just kind of... take things as they come, I guess.
Do you often feel like you're observing life from outside of yourself, or like people and things around you aren't really real?
No, I... I don't think so. I haven't ever really felt like that.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with focusing on your work?

Um... I guess it's been noticeably worse for... maybe 11 months? Give or take. The school changed the curriculum calendar around then... and they added these after-school planning meetings. So... yeah. Since about then.
Do you feel upset or frustrated when you realize you've been staring at the same page for a long time without making progress?
Um... not really. I don't know, I don't really get upset about it. It just... is what it is, I guess.
Do you feel emotionally drained or upset about your situation at school?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, it's just work. I don't really think about it that way.
Do you think your mind going blank and having trouble focusing might be related to worrying about something, even if you don't feel like you're worrying?
Um... no. I don't think so. I'm not really worrying about anything. It just... goes blank, I guess. That's all.
Do you think you're putting off certain tasks at work because they're unpleasant or boring?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... put things off sometimes, I guess. I don't know if it's because they're boring.
Have you been experiencing any physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or trembling when you're trying to focus on your work?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't get sweaty or... anything physical. It's just normal, I guess.
Have you experienced a decrease in interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?
Not really. I mean... I still like doing the same things. Nothing's really changed there, I don't think.
